envelope.description: chain.ts: replace the 6 mechanical dead-string approve-*/sync-tracker sites with real MCP call shapes

body.title: chain.ts: replace the 6 mechanical dead-string approve-*/sync-tracker sites with real MCP call shapes
body.summary: In computeNextAction, swap the 6 return sites at lines 341, 356, 378, 399, 422 (approve-define x2, approve-hld, approve-lld x2) and 438 (sync-tracker) from `insrc workflow approve/sync ...` to insrc_workflow_approve({artifactPath:"<real path>"}) / insrc_workflow_step(phase='start', workflow='tracker.sync', params={epicHash}) -- pure string swaps, no new data needed, no existing test's .command.includes(...) assertion content changes (the real path string is still embedded).
acceptanceChecks: Every one of the 6 sites' command string matches insrc_workflow_approve({artifactPath:...}) or insrc_workflow_step(phase='start', workflow='tracker.sync', ...) and still contains the real artifact path / epicHash it always did.
No other NextAction kind's command string (run-define, run-hld, run-lld, push-tracker) changes.

tests.name: computeNextAction returns insrc_workflow_approve/insrc_workflow_step call shapes (not the dead insrc-workflow-CLI strings) for approve-define, approve-hld, approve-lld and sync-tracker, across both the main and issue-anchored branches
